result.title: Fast and Useful: Adapting Distilled Generators for Visual Learning
result.summary: Distilled text-to-image models generate images quickly, but classifiers trained on those images can perform substantially worse than classifiers trained on images from their slower base models. We adapt released distilled generators to produce better training data while retaining fast generation. We fit a low-rank update to the student's first prediction so that it reaches an intermediate state produced by its unguided base, then disable the update and let the unchanged student finish generation. The base supplies training targets and is absent at inference. Guided targets and shorter jumps give classifiers lower accuracy in our ablations, showing why the state used for supervision matters. Across three generator families, the adapted images train better classifiers than images from the released students. With class-name templates at full ImageNet-1k scale, ResNet-50 top-1 rises from 8.4% to 34.2% for FLUX.2-klein and from 12.7% to 32.1% for SD-Turbo, using two and three denoiser evaluations per image, respectively. Fixed adapters also improve results on additional classes, fine-grained datasets, and other learner architectures and training recipes. Template-based adaptation remains useful against richer-prompt alternatives, while the benefit of combining adaptation with LLM generation prompts depends on the generator. Adapting a single generation step makes fast generators substantially more useful for training visual models.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为蒸馏文生图模型拟合一个低秩更新，使其首步预测对齐到基座模型的中间状态，随后撤掉更新由原学生模型完成生成，从而在保持快速采样的同时产出能训练出更好分类器的图像。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对齐学生早期状态到基座中间状态」的低秩轨迹修正与监督状态选择消融，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹对齐、中间状态监督与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索，但任务本身是图像生成数据，与 VLM 推理无直接关系。
